subject: OKR inventory, risk mitigation, and cross-team gating asks
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Park <sarah@acmecloud.com>, procure@boxco.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OKR inventory, risk mitigation, and cross-team gating asks

Team — mid-quarter check here. For Q3 planning and our upcoming QBR I need a concise inventory of high-risk OKRs across product + infra that could materially affect our QBR commitments. Specifically: 

1) For every OKR you own or influence, mark status: on-track / at-risk / off-track.
2) For at-risk / off-track items, give a 1–2 line cause, the mitigation you propose, and the owner(s) we can point to for execution.
3) Call out any external gating (procurement, partner integration windows, regulatory reviews) and expected unblock ETA.
4) Indicate any proposed re-scope (what we would deprioritize) and the customer or revenue impact.

Please update the attached risk register with your entries (Q2-risk-register.xlsx) and drop a one-paragraph update in reply here by EOD Wednesday (2026-07-08). If you need more time, call it out now.

High priority items I already know about: quantization throughput for us-east models, Dedicated capacity procurement, and the Acme Cloud integration. Marcus, please lead the inventory for latency and inference cost OKRs. Laura, please cover rollout and canary policy updates. Vivek, any cross-org capacity asks please list them here so I can escalate.

Shared doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cQ-OKR-RiskRegister
HubSpot deal (Acme): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4512712

Thanks — concise bullets preferred.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman | VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q2-risk-register.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sarah Park <sarah@acmecloud.com>, procure@boxco.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OKR inventory, risk mitigation, and cross-team gating asks

On Mon, Jul 6, 2026 at 9:12 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — mid-quarter check here. For Q3 planning and our upcoming QBR I need a concise inventory of high-risk OKRs...

Naomi — quick inventory from latency/cost side (TL;DR below). I've also uploaded a first-pass canary plan. See attachment: canary-deployment-plan.pdf

OKR: Reduce 99th percentile latency for streaming endpoints by 30% (owner: marcus_lin)
- Status: at-risk
- Cause: quantization regression observed on LLM-v2-512 when batch sizes spike; kernel falls back to slower path for long sequences.
- Mitigation: temporarily restrict quantized variant to short-seq routes, prioritize kernel fix (seq-aware kernel selection) for v2. ETA for kernel patch: 3 weeks (2026-07-27).
- External gating: needs Dedicated infra increase to test at scale (2x A100-equivalent for canaries). Procurement ticket submitted to procure@boxco.com (ref: PR-789).
- Proposed re-scope: reduce target to 20% improvement for streaming during canary period; defers full 30% to post-QBR if procurement delays persist. Customer impact: minor performance regression for <1% of sessions (highest-latency tail).

OKR: Inference cost per 1M tokens down 15% (owner: marcus_lin)
- Status: at-risk
- Cause: caching hit-rate lower than expected on multi-tenant workloads; prefix fragmentation.
- Mitigation: implement prefix compaction + adaptive cache TTLs (work in progress). ETA: 4 weeks.

TL;DR actions from me:
- Request 2x Dedicated GPUs for staging canaries (procure@boxco.com).
- Prioritize kernel patch work (I'll escalate to infra team today).
- If procurement takes >2 weeks, accept temporary re-scope for latency OKR to 20%.

Marcus
Marcus Lin | Director, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: canary-deployment-plan.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sarah Park <sarah@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OKR inventory, risk mitigation, and cross-team gating asks

Thanks Marcus — notes from rollout / product side: 

- Proposal: narrow the latency OKR surface to the top-3 public endpoints (chat-stream, summarization, embeddings) for the QBR timeframe. This keeps customer-facing SLAs intact and limits testing matrix for canaries.
- Owner assignments: 
  - chat-stream: marcus_lin + priyom_das (runtime)
  - summarization: laura_bennett + hannah_schmitt (product)
  - embeddings: vivek_kulkarni + rishi_malhotra (infra)
- Canary acceptance criteria: 95th percentile within 10% of baseline and no increase in error rate >0.1% over 48 hours. (See canary-deployment-plan.pdf)
- If procurement is delayed, we'll shift rollout to a staged traffic-split (10% -> 25% -> 50%) using current capacity and length-limit configs. That mitigates exposure but delays full latency improvements.

I support Marcus's recommended temporary re-scope to 20% as a fallback. Uploading a short runbook to the shared Drive now.

Laura
Laura Bennett | Head of Product | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: OKR inventory, risk mitigation, and cross-team gating asks

Hi Naomi / Marcus / Laura — thanks for the heads up and detailed notes. Quick response from Acme: 

- Integration window: we can move our pilot to the week of 7/27 to align with your kernel patch ETA if that helps.
- Procurement: we can issue a temporary test-access token on our side to avoid waiting on new Dedicated capacity immediately (valid for 2 weeks). That would allow you to validate the patch at representative scale.
- SLA ask: for the QBR judgement, Acme will accept a temporary 20% target for streaming latency if you commit to the 7/27 follow-up and a shared canary report.

I'd like a 30-minute sync to align on the canary runbook and token handoff. I'm available Tue 7/7 after 10:00 PT or Wed 7/8 between 09:00–11:00 PT.

—Sarah
Sarah Park | Head of Platform Partnerships | Acme Cloud

Subject: Re: OKR inventory, risk mitigation, and cross-team gating asks — consolidated actions

Folks — thanks for the quick turn. Consolidated actions for QBR prep and next steps: 

1) Marcus: open an internal ticket to prioritize kernel patch; update ETA in the Drive by EOD tomorrow. Owner: marcus_lin.
2) Procurement: @procure (procure@boxco.com) please prioritize PR-789; request is 2x A100-equivalent for staging. If you can't meet that, please propose the fastest alternative.
3) Laura & Marcus: narrow scope to top-3 endpoints for the QBR. Upload the abbreviated OKR definition to the shared doc.
4) Acme: Sarah — appreciate the temporary test token offer. Let's take Tue 7/7 10:30 PT for a 30-minute canary sync. Marcus, please bring the canary runbook and telemetry checklist.
5) Vivek: call out any cross-org capacity or ops runbook gaps by EOD 7/7 so I can escalate to infra leadership.
6) All: update the attached risk register with final statuses and mitigations (Q2-risk-register.xlsx) and add a short note under the "QBR-ready" column if you are shipping a mitigant before 7/27.

I'll summarize these items in the QBR pack and flag any open procurement or partner risks for the executive readout. If anything changes after your updates, add a short inline reply rather than a long thread.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman | VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
